articles.summary: Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. 1 (NYSE: JXN), announced today that Dean Hosfield has been named Senior Vice President and Chief Information Officer, effective October 5. Hosfield brings extensive executive leadership experience across technology, digital transformation and business strategy within the insurance industry. Hosfield, who previously spent 17 years at Jackson, will report to Laura Hanson, Executive Vice President, Operations and Technology Services for Jackson. “Dean is a proven technology leader in the insurance industry and I’m thrilled to welcome him back to Jackson,” said Hanson. “Throughout his career, Dean has focused on helping organizations leverage technology to drive business results and customer value, while leading large-scale technology modernization and cloud transformation efforts.
